user.title: Create Tesla Fleet API app
user.description: Create a Tesla developer application according to the instructions in the expand in the [Tesla Fleet integration documentation](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/tesla_fleet/) but make the domain the domain of your internet-exposed Home Assistant server.
